measurement: Retrospective edition replays executed 2026-11-19 UTC. The 11/04 empty stores and 11/05 next-day stores use separate recomputed windows. Same-date reranks use previous pilot artifacts. Amounts are USD from model token ledgers at repository pricing, excluding CI and infrastructure. Later metadata revisions may be present.

sampling.math: Public October and November arXiv listings for math.NT, math.NA and stat.ME, separate from the ingest API. Per listing sample five by SHA-256(ID) from the last fifth of October, first third or last half of November. Read each v1 abstract page for submission day and apply the seven-day window. Listed categories may include cross-listings. There were 45 unique v1 pages in the sample.
sampling.earth-environment: All DOIs in the five Copernicus journal volume tables for the exact seven publication days. Empty journal windows contribute zero.
sampling.chemistry: All Europe PMC DOI records returned by ISSN and FIRST_PDATE for the window. Compare by DOI to the restricted Crossref collection; index publication dates and licence/abstract availability differ. Store and rank totals use all DOI references; show up to five DOI examples per journal in hash order.
